name: ref-20-local-vetting
description: TSP reference rung 20 — the peer identity vetting ceremony against a local VTI stack (community_vetting_subtask.md P2). vtc-admin.mjs drives the community-admin REST surface the CLI cannot reach on this build: the /v1/auth/challenge -> eddsa-jcs-2022-signed /v1/auth/ handshake, then endorsement-type registration, the accepts criterion, and vetter grants.
